line.en: antiques, vintage and old records around la latina, roughly 9 to 15. come by metro, not car.
line.de: antiquitäten, vintage und alte platten rund um la latina, etwa 9 bis 15 uhr. mit der u-bahn kommen, nicht mit dem auto.
line.tr: la latina çevresinde antikalar, vintage ve eski plaklar, yaklaşık 9 ile 15 arası. arabayla değil metroyla gel.

sparks.why: El Rastro is held every Sunday roughly 9:00-15:00 in La Latina; described in the lamaletainquieta.com Rastro guide and on esmadrid.com (anticuarios y almonedas). No special schedule for 29.11 was found.
